proposal.hypothesis: Exploratory single-deletion hypothesis: cf5a339b0cd90 can retain completed play without supplied-engine searches after removing own from the defined ability phrase while preserving own before knowledge. The contrast with c91be84043ecf suggests, but does not establish, that this remaining modifier could matter. Support requires 3/3 valid clean completions; any supplied-engine search refutes the perfect-cohort prediction, and missing, partial, or errored games do not support it.
proposal.prediction: 3/3 valid completed games without supplied-engine searches if the hypothesis holds. Audit any favorable cohort for alternate computation; matching small-cohort outcomes do not establish equivalence.
proposal.ablation: Relative to cf5a339b0cd90, delete only the first own and its following space from the asset. Relative to c91be84043ecf, add only own before knowledge. Hold the exact linked opening, /workdir/definition.md location, all remaining original game text, and actor settings fixed. The accompanying condition instead removes the second own, giving an equal-word-count and equal-byte-count positional contrast. Each asset is 13 words and 92 UTF-8 bytes with no title or trailing newline. Count all file words and link/target costs; zero added visible prompt words is not an unchanged task. Comparisons to previously measured parents remain temporally unmatched.

costs.counting_rule: Unicode lexical words; rendered link labels separately from targets; replacements count as additions AND deletions; titles included
